name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 4px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px solid white inner ring for interactive elements. This ensures high contrast against any background while keeping the ring visible on dark or light themes. The trade-off is slightly larger visual footprint, but it guarantees keyboard users can always see where they are.

name: Reader
text: The 4px outer ring with 2px white inner ring still risks blurring on low-contrast backgrounds when users zoom or switch themes. A 3px solid #005fcc ring with a 1px white inner ring keeps the footprint smaller while maintaining visibility. Test it at 200% zoom on a light gray background—if the ring remains crisp, it’s the better choice.
